title_en: Displaced Palestinians protest as Israeli air strikes continue in Gaza
title_zh: 以色列继续空袭加沙，流离失所的巴勒斯坦人抗议
summary: Israeli forces continue to destroy residential buildings as part of a 'gradual displacement' policy, a Gaza mayor says.
summary_zh: 加沙市长表示，作为“逐步流离失所”政策的一部分，以色列军队继续摧毁住宅建筑。
body_en: Share Displaced Palestinians protest as Israeli air strikes continue in Gaza on social media
Hundreds of displaced Palestinians have protested as Israeli forces continue to destroy residential buildings in Gaza, beyond the line they withdrew to under last year’s ceasefire.

Al Jazeera journalist Moath al-Kahlout, reporting from Gaza’s Deir el-Balah, said displaced Palestinians who live in the area near the “Yellow Line” gathered on Saturday to demonstrate against Israel’s intensifying air strikes.

The “ Yellow Line” separates Israeli- and Hamas-controlled areas in Gaza since the “ceasefire” signed in October 2025.
“More than 500 housing units have been destroyed in less than a month,” said Mohammed Musleh, mayor of Deir-el Balah’s Maghazi municipality, told Al Jazeera.
“This is part of what appears to be a systematic policy of gradual creeping displacement aimed at forcing residents out of their camp and destroying as many homes as possible,” Musleh said.
Gaza’s Ministry of Public Works and Housing says 350,000 families are homeless after Israeli attacks destroyed 80 percent of the enclave’s homes.
Meanwhile, flooding in recent weeks devastated temporary tent housing , the ministry said.

The original “Yellow Line”, established under US President Donald Trump’s 20-point plan to end Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, marked the area to which Israeli forces initially withdrew. They were expected to make further withdrawals gradually, but instead seized more territory.
“If we go back to October 2025, when the ceasefire was signed, the ‘Yellow Line’ was much further east,” al-Kahlout said.
Now, nearly two-thirds of Gaza is under Israeli army control or subject to access restrictions.
Israeli attacks killed at least four Palestinians in Gaza on Saturday, including three who died when an Israeli drone struck a van delivering food aid to displaced people in Gaza City.
In the past 48 hours, Israeli strikes killed at least nine people, taking the death toll since the October 2025 “ceasefire” to 1,661, according to the latest report from Gaza’s Ministry of Health.
The ministry said 55 Palestinians were wounded in the past 48 hours, putting the total number of the wounded since October 2025 at 6,062.

Gaza’s Civil Defence said on Saturday that its crew members recovered the bodies and remains of 129 people from 39 homes and other Israeli-destroyed buildings in the Nuseirat refugee camp, az-Zawayda and Deir el-Balah in central Gaza.
Rami al-Aidi, Civil Defence director in central Gaza, said 233 people had been reported missing beneath the rubble of those buildings.
The 53-day operation marked the conclusion of the second phase of a recovery project in central Gaza funded by the International Committee of the Red Cross.
body_zh: 分享 以色列继续空袭加沙，流离失所的巴勒斯坦人在社交媒体上抗议
数百名流离失所的巴勒斯坦人抗议以色列军队继续摧毁加沙的住宅建筑，超出了去年停火协议规定的撤军线。
半岛电视台记者莫斯·卡鲁特从加沙代尔巴拉赫报道说，居住在“黄线”附近地区的流离失所的巴勒斯坦人周六聚集在一起示威，反对以色列加强空袭。

列表 3 次以色列对加沙分发粮食援助车辆的袭击中的 2 次造成三人死亡

自2025年10月签署“停火”以来，“黄线”将加沙地带以色列和哈马斯控制的地区分开。
代尔巴拉赫马加齐市市长穆罕默德·穆斯莱 (Mohammed Musleh) 告诉半岛电视台：“不到一个月的时间，就有超过 500 套住房被毁。”
穆斯勒说：“这似乎是一项系统性政策的一部分，该政策旨在迫使居民离开营地并摧毁尽可能多的房屋。”
加沙公共工程和住房部表示，以色列的袭击摧毁了该飞地 80% 的房屋，导致 35 万家庭无家可归。
与此同时，该部表示，最近几周的洪水摧毁了临时帐篷。
最初的“黄线”是根据美国总统唐纳德·特朗普结束以色列对加沙种族灭绝战争的20点计划设立的，标志着以色列军队最初撤退的地​​区。他们预计将逐步进一步撤军，但实际上却夺取了更多领土。
卡鲁特说：“如果我们回到 2025 年 10 月签署停火协议时，‘黄线’会向东延伸得多。”
现在，近三分之二的加沙地区处于以色列军队控制之下或受到出入限制。
周六，以色列的袭击造成加沙至少四名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中三人因以色列无人机撞上一辆向加沙城流离失所者运送粮食援助的货车而死亡。
加沙卫生部的最新报告称，过去48小时内，以色列的空袭造成至少9人死亡，使自2025年10月“停火”以来的死亡人数达到1661人。
该部表示，过去 48 小时内有 55 名巴勒斯坦人受伤，自 2025 年 10 月以来受伤总人数为 6,062 人。
加沙民防部门周六表示，其工作人员从加沙中部努塞拉特难民营、扎韦达难民营和代尔巴拉赫难民营的 39 所房屋和其他被以色列摧毁的建筑中找到了 129 人的尸体和遗骸。
加沙中部民防主任拉米·艾迪表示，据报告有 233 人在这些建筑物的废墟下失踪。
为期53天的行动标志着红十字国际委员会资助的加沙中部恢复项目第二阶段的结束。

title_en: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
title_zh: 驶往俄罗斯的船只在芬兰湾遭遇袭击
summary: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on the vessel.
summary_zh: 芬兰国防军表示，乌克兰很可能是无人机袭击该船的幕后黑手。
body_en: A Russian cargo vessel bound for the country's Baltic exclave Kaliningrad has been hit by a drone attack in the eastern Gulf of Finland, Russian and Finnish authorities say.

The ship - the Sparta II - caught on fire after the strike on Saturday morning, before drifting into Finnish waters. Finnish defence forces said Ukraine was likely behind the attack. Kyiv has yet to comment.
"War is spilling over into our immediate vicinity," Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said. "Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor."
Kaliningrad Governor Alexei Besprozvannykh said two drones had been used, based on preliminary information, and there was "no threat" to the territory's supplies.
The Sparta II was sanctioned by the US in 2022 and Ukraine earlier this year, and is run by a Russian company, according to the Ukrainian and US governments.
The company says on its website that it was established within the structure of Russia's defence ministry in 2011 and since 2015 has been operating within the military construction complex.

Finland's coast guard said it had been alerted to the attack at around 08:50 local time (06:50 GMT) on Saturday and that the cargo vessel had been located approximately 50km west of the island of Suursaari in the Gulf of Finland.
This prompted "temporary aviation and maritime restrictions" around the area, Finnish border officials said.
Shortly after the incident, Finland's defence ministry said a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating the country's airspace, potentially linked to "rescue or tracking operations".

A Russian rescue vessel approached the ship and was told by the crew that they did not need to be evacuated, Kaliningrad's governor wrote on Telegram, adding: "The crew is currently carrying out the necessary work and plans to continue on its way."

The Finnish Border Guard later said the crew had been evacuated to another Russian vessel that was now already en route to Russia. The Russian rescue vessel had remained at the location of the stricken ship.
It added that no environmental damage had been detected and that there was no danger to maritime traffic or people.
Kaliningrad is a Russian exclave that sits between Poland and Lithuania.
Defence Minister Antti Häkkänen said that the Finnish Border Guard were responsible for the investigation into the attack and were co-operating with other relevant authorities.
Nato has also been informed, the defence ministry said.

The Baltic Sea has become a flashpoint in the Russia-Ukraine war, triggered when Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Ukraine has recently ramped up its long-range attacks against Russia beyond the front lines.
Earlier this month, a Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland .

body_zh: 俄罗斯和芬兰当局称，一艘开往该国波罗的海飞地加里宁格勒的俄罗斯货船在芬兰湾东部遭到无人机袭击。
这艘名为“斯巴达二号”的船在周六早上的袭击后起火，随后漂入芬兰水域。芬兰国防军表示，乌克兰很可能是此次袭击的幕后黑手。基辅尚未发表评论。
芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波表示：“战争正在蔓延到我们附近。” “乌克兰有权反击侵略者。”
加里宁格勒州长阿列克谢·贝斯普罗兹万内赫表示，根据初步信息，使用了两架无人机，该地区的供应“没有受到威胁”。
据乌克兰和美国政府称，Sparta II 于 2022 年受到美国和今年早些时候乌克兰的制裁，由一家俄罗斯公司运营。
该公司在其网站上表示，它于 2011 年在俄罗斯国防部的框架内成立，自 2015 年以来一直在军事建筑群内运营。
芬兰海岸警卫队表示，已于周六当地时间 08:50（格林威治标准时间 06:50）左右接到袭击警报，该货船位于芬兰湾 Suursaari 岛以西约 50 公里处。
芬兰边境官员表示，这促使该地区周围出现“临时航空和海上限制”。
事件发生后不久，芬兰国防部表示，一架俄罗斯直升机涉嫌侵犯该国领空，可能与“救援或追踪行动”有关。
加里宁格勒州长在 Telegram 上写道，一艘俄罗斯救援船接近该船，船员告诉他们不需要撤离，并补充道：“船员目前正在进行必要的工作，并计划继续航行。”
芬兰边防卫队后来表示，船员已被疏散到另一艘俄罗斯船只上，该船只目前已在前往俄罗斯的途中。俄罗斯救援船仍留在失事船只所在地。
它补充说，没有发现环境破坏，海上交通或人员没有危险。
加里宁格勒是位于波兰和立陶宛之间的俄罗斯飞地。
国防部长安蒂·哈卡宁表示，芬兰边防卫队负责对袭击事件进行调查，并正在与其他有关当局合作。
国防部表示，北约也已获悉此事。
波罗的海已成为俄乌战争的爆发点，起因是俄罗斯于2022年对乌克兰发动全面入侵。乌克兰最近加大了对俄罗斯前线以外地区的远程攻击力度。
本月早些时候，乌克兰无人机袭击了芬兰湾的一艘俄罗斯军舰。

title_en: Russia strikes Zelenskyy's hometown, killing 2
title_zh: 俄罗斯空袭泽伦斯基家乡 造成2人死亡
summary: The attacks follow Russian President Vladimir Putin's vow of a "painful" response to Ukraine's attacks this week on the Kerch Bridge, linking Russian-occupied Crimea.
summary_zh: 此前，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京誓言将对乌克兰本周对刻赤大桥的袭击做出“痛苦”回应。
body_en: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Ukraine's southern city of Kryvyi Rih — President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown — killed two people and wounded dozens of others, local officials said Saturday.

The attacks come amid little progress in talks to end the nearly five-year-old war and after Ukraine, on three occasions this week, struck the Kerch bridge linking Russian-occupied Crimea with Russia.
Russian President Vladimir Putin had vowed a "painful" response to the Kerch attack, as the bridge is vital for war supplies for Russian forces in the south.

Among the dead in Friday evening's double-tap strikes on Kryvyi Rih were a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman, while several children were among the 60 wounded, the Ukrainian officials said.

Several fires broke out and damage was caused to about 25 apartment buildings, a hospital, schools and an industrial facility, Oleksandr Vilkul, the head of the city administration, wrote on Telegram.
Moscow, meanwhile, confirmed a further strike on Friday night in Kryvyi Rih.
Russia's Defense Ministry said a thermal power plant in the city was hit, along with a power substation in the region of Rivne, on the opposite side of the country.
Both facilities supply electricity to the industry supporting Ukraine's military, the ministry added.
Elsewhere in the nearly five-year-long war, Russia ​also struck a ​cargo vessel ‌near Odesa, which Moscow said was carrying dual-use goods ​for ⁠the Ukrainian military.
Eleven people, including two children, were wounded when a Russian drone attacked a five-story apartment building in the northeastern Kharkiv region, Ukraine’s State Emergency Service said Saturday.
One person was wounded in a Russian attack on the capital, Kyiv, according to the service.
In Russia, local officials said Saturday that Ukrainian drone attacks wounded three people in the Bryansk and Belgorod border regions.

Finland , meanwhile, said it detected a drone attack on Saturday morning on a Russian cargo ship in the eastern Baltic Sea, prompting Prime Minister Petteri Orpo to warn that the war is "spilling over into our immediate vicinity."
After damage to Russia's Kerch bridge to Crimea, Zelenskyy warned in an interview with US broadcaster NBC that the structure "will not remain standing anyway."

title_en: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting
title_zh: 泽伦斯基表示克里米亚大桥在会见英国议员斯特里廷时得到了“公平的回应”
summary: Ukraine's president says Kyiv acted after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine.
summary_zh: 乌克兰总统表示，基辅在俄罗斯对乌克兰桥梁进行 109 次空袭后采取了行动。
body_en: By Sarah Rainsford , Southern and Eastern Europe correspondent in Kyiv and Jaroslav Lukiv

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has justified Kyiv's repeated attacks on a critical bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, calling it a "fair response" to 109 separate Russian attacks on bridges in Ukraine.

In comments to the BBC in Kyiv, Zelensky said the intense attacks on Ukraine by Russia that have followed the strikes on the Crimean Bridge were only a "signal that Vladimir Putin does not want to stop. He wants a reason to escalate".
He rejected the claim by the Russian president that the bridge - which links Russia to the peninsula it illegally annexed from Ukraine - was "exclusively civilian" in use.
"There are facts, not just the words of Putin. We can see," he said.
The Ukrainian president pointed to images online of tanks and other Russian military hardware using the route from Russia into occupied Crimea as a supply line and for logistics.
"If Putin used the internet, he could see that."
The Ukrainian president added that Russia had carried out attacks with missiles and drones on bridges in Ukraine.

This week's combined missile-and-drone strikes by Ukrainian forces destroyed the central road section of the Crimean Bridge, collapsing part of it together with one of the two support arches into the sea and rendering the structure unusable for road traffic.

Russian attacks on Ukraine continued on Friday evening and overnight: a seven-year-old boy was killed in missile and drone strikes on Zelensky's hometown of Kryvyi Rih in the central Dnipropetrovsk region. Local officials say he had been in a playground at the time.

A 20-year-old female medic was also killed. A local official added that when rescuers rushed to the scene, the same site was targeted again with jet powered drones. Another 58 people were injured in the city.
Ukraine's state emergency service DSNS said 11 people were also injured in the north-eastern Kharkiv region, and one person in Rivne, in the north-west.
Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
Zelensky was speaking ahead of a meeting in Kyiv with UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting, who told the Ukrainian president he was here to show that Europe was united in its support.
"The more Putin tries to divide us, the more resolute we become," Streeting said.
He said that Russian missiles hitting Poland on Friday, during military exercises of the so-called Coalition of the Willing, was an "outrageous provocation".
The timing, Streeting said, seemed "more than a coincidence".
Asked by the BBC about Nato's response, he said the best way was to "do more for Ukraine" to defend itself against Putin who he called a "cold-blooded killer".

Streeting's description of Putin chimed with the comments made earlier by Zelensky, who described the Kremlin leader a "killer". This was done in response to US President Donald Trump referring this week to Putin as his "friend".
Streeting's visit to Kyiv came after European leaders meeting in Berlin on Thursday alongside US envoys said they were ready for negotiations with Moscow on ending the war in Ukraine.
body_zh: 作者：莎拉·雷恩斯福德 (Sarah Rainsford)，南欧和东欧驻基辅记者和雅罗斯拉夫·卢基夫 (Jaroslav Lukiv)
乌克兰总统泽连斯基为基辅一再袭击连接俄罗斯和被占领克里米亚的一座重要桥梁辩护，称这是对俄罗斯 109 次袭击乌克兰桥梁的“公平回应”。
泽伦斯基在基辅接受英国广播公司采访时表示，克里米亚大桥袭击事件后，俄罗斯对乌克兰发动猛烈袭击，这只是“弗拉基米尔·普京不想停止的信号。他想要一个升级的理由”。
他驳斥了俄罗斯总统的说法，即这座连接俄罗斯与俄罗斯从乌克兰非法吞并的半岛的桥梁“仅供民用”使用。
“这是事实，而不仅仅是普京的话。我们可以看到，”他说。
乌克兰总统指出，网上显示坦克和其他俄罗斯军事装备的图片，使用从俄罗斯进入被占领克里米亚的路线作为补给线和后勤保障。
“如果普京使用互联网，他就能看到这一点。”
乌克兰总统补充说，俄罗斯使用导弹和无人机对乌克兰的桥梁进行了袭击。
乌克兰军队本周的导弹和无人机联合袭击摧毁了克里米亚大桥的中央路段，部分大桥连同两个支撑拱门之一倒塌入海，导致该结构无法用于道路交通。
周五晚上和夜间，俄罗斯对乌克兰的袭击仍在继续：一名七岁男孩在泽连斯基家乡第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区中部克里沃罗格的导弹和无人机袭击中丧生。当地官员称，他当时正在操场上。
一名20岁的女医生也被杀。一名当地官员补充说，当救援人员赶到现场时，同一地点再次遭到喷气式无人机袭击。该市另有58人受伤。
乌克兰国家紧急服务机构DSNS表示，东北部哈尔科夫地区也有11人受伤，西北部罗夫诺也有1人受伤。
俄罗斯于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵。
泽伦斯基是在基辅与英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷会面之前发表上述言论的。斯特里廷告诉乌克兰总统，他来这里是为了表明欧洲团结一致支持。
“普京越是试图分裂我们，我们就越坚决，”斯特里廷说。
他表示，周五在所谓的“自愿联盟”军事演习期间，俄罗斯导弹袭击了波兰，这是一次“无耻的挑衅”。
斯特里廷说，这个时机似乎“不仅仅是巧合”。
在被英国广播公司问及北约的反应时，他表示，最好的办法是“为乌克兰做更多事情”，以抵御普京，他称普京为“冷血杀手”。
斯特里廷对普京的描述与泽伦斯基早些时候的评论不谋而合，泽伦斯基将这位克里姆林宫领导人描述为“杀手”。这样做是为了回应美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本周将普京称为他的“朋友”。
斯特里廷访问基辅之前，欧洲领导人周四与美国特使在柏林会面，表示他们已准备好与莫斯科就结束乌克兰战争进行谈判。

title_en: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
title_zh: FBI十大通缉名单上的墨西哥毒枭在枪战中被捕
summary: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores, who is accused of drug trafficking and torture, is detained after gun fight with authorities.
summary_zh: 福斯托·伊西德罗·“矮子·伊迪斯罗”·梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Fausto Isidro "Chapo Idisro" Meza Flores) 被指控贩毒和酷刑，在与当局发生枪战后被拘留。
body_en: A Mexican drug lord who was on the FBI's 10 most wanted list has been arrested following a shoot-out with Mexican authorities.
Fausto Isidro "Chapo Isidro" Meza Flores and seven others were detained by Mexican special forces in Guasave, Sinaloa on Friday, Mexico's defence secretariat said.
Seven suspects were killed in the operation, as were four members of the Mexican army who were travelling to reinforce security in Guasave, the secretariat added.

Meza Flores was wanted in Mexico on organised crime charges, while he has been accused of "flooding the US with fentanyl, cocaine, heroin and other deadly drugs" by the FBI. The US is seeking his extradition.
Mexico has stepped up efforts to tackle drug-related crime after coming under pressure from US President Donald Trump since he returned to the White House.

Meza Flores, the leader of the Meza Flores Organisation, also known as the Guasave Cartel, is thought to have been active in the drug trafficking trade since the 1990s but managed to evade authorities till now by maintaining a relatively low profile.

Using US intelligence on his whereabouts, Mexican special forces descended on his location using "stealth and surprise", establishing a perimeter to prevent him from escaping and reinforcements arriving, Mexico's defence secretariat said.
However, they "came under attack from gunfire and explosives" before entering the property and arresting Meza Flores, the secretariat continued.
Videos circulating online appear to show helicopters firing streams of bullets towards the ground in Guasave. Others appear to show people at a baseball stadium fleeing as they hear shooting sounds.
Eight people in total were arrested, including Meza Flores' second-in-command, who is also his cousin, and his brother-in-law, who is the group's financial operator, the secretariat added.
Meza Flores, his cousin, and his brother-in-law were flown to Mexico City to face prosecution, the defence secretariat said. The other five remained in the state of Sinaloa.
Authorities also said they had seized multiple weapons during the operation, including a grenade launcher, as well as drugs and cash.

The US Consulate General in the city of Hermosillo said it was "monitoring reports of ongoing security operations, armed clashes, road blockades, and vehicle fires that occurred overnight in Ahome, Guamúchil, Guasave, and Navolato" following the arrest of Meza-Flores.
It advised US citizens to remain alert for potential violence in the area and for residents to remain sheltered in place.
When Meza Flores was added to the FBI's most-wanted list in 2025, he was accused of "heinous crimes" including kidnapping, extortion and torture.
Then-acting FBI director Brian Driscoll said Meza Flores and his organisation had also unleashed a "scourge of illicit drugs" into the US via its southern border with Mexico.
He was initially charged with drug trafficking in the US in 2012 before being charged again in 2019.
The 44-year-old is alleged to have conspired to manufacture and distribute large quantities of cocaine, heroin, methamphetamine and marijuana between 2005 and 2019.
Meza Flores was originally a high-ranking member of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, but a split between rival factions led to a surge of violence and prompted him to establish his own cartel by 2013.

His organisation has also engaged in what US officials described as an "extremely violent turf war" with the Sinaloa Cartel, one of the most powerful drug trafficking gangs, which operates in the same region.
body_zh: 美国联邦调查局十大通缉名单上的一名墨西哥毒枭在与墨西哥当局发生枪战后被捕。
墨西哥国防部秘书处称，福斯托·伊西德罗·“矮子伊西德罗”·梅萨·弗洛雷斯和其他七人周五在锡那罗亚州瓜萨维被墨西哥特种部队拘留。
秘书处补充说，七名嫌疑人在行动中被打死，四名前往瓜萨韦加强安全的墨西哥军队成员也被打死。
梅萨·弗洛雷斯因有组织犯罪指控在墨西哥被通缉，而联邦调查局则指控他“向美国大量输送芬太尼、可卡因、海洛因和其他致命毒品”。美国正在寻求引渡他。
自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普重返白宫以来，墨西哥在其压力下加大了打击毒品相关犯罪的力度。
梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 是梅萨·弗洛雷斯组织 (Meza Flores Organization)（又名 Guasave 卡特尔）的领导人，据信自 20 世纪 90 年代以来一直活跃于贩毒行业，但迄今为止一直保持相对低调，设法逃避当局的追捕。
墨西哥国防秘书处表示，墨西哥特种部队利用美国关于他行踪的情报，以“秘密和突然”方式袭击了他的所在地，建立了一个边界，以防止他逃跑和增援部队抵达。
然而，秘书处继续说，他们在进入该房产并逮捕梅萨·弗洛雷斯之前“遭到枪击和爆炸物的袭击”。
网上流传的视频似乎显示，直升机向瓜萨韦的地面发射子弹流。其他照片似乎显示棒球场里的人们听到枪声后纷纷逃跑。
秘书处补充说，共有八人被捕，其中包括梅萨·弗洛雷斯的二号人物（也是他的表弟）和他的妹夫（该组织的金融运营商）。
国防部秘书处称，梅萨·弗洛雷斯、他的表弟和姐夫已飞往墨西哥城接受起诉。另外五个留在锡那罗亚州。
当局还表示，他们在行动中缴获了多件武器，包括榴弹发射器，以及毒品和现金。
美国驻埃莫西约市总领事馆表示，梅萨-弗洛雷斯被捕后，正在“监测阿霍姆、瓜穆奇尔、瓜萨韦和纳沃拉托夜间发生的安全行动、武装冲突、道路封锁和车辆火灾的报告”。
它建议美国公民对该地区潜在的暴力保持警惕，并建议居民留在原地避难。
2025 年，当梅萨·弗洛雷斯 (Meza Flores) 被列入联邦调查局 (FBI) 通缉名单时，他被指控犯有绑架、勒索和酷刑等“令人发指的罪行”。
时任联邦调查局代理局长布莱恩·德里斯科尔表示，梅萨·弗洛雷斯和他的组织还通过美国南部与墨西哥的边境向美国释放了“非法毒品祸害”。
他最初于 2012 年在美国被指控犯有贩毒罪，然后于 2019 年再次受到指控。
这名 44 岁的男子被指控在 2005 年至 2019 年间密谋制造和分销大量可卡因、海洛因、甲基苯丙胺和大麻。
梅萨·弗洛雷斯原本是贝尔特兰·雷瓦组织的高级成员，但敌对派系之间的分裂导致暴力事件激增，并促使他在 2013 年建立了自己的卡特尔。
他的组织还与锡那罗亚贩毒集团进行了美国官员所说的“极其暴力的地盘争夺战”，锡那罗亚贩毒集团是在同一地区活动的最强大的贩毒团伙之一。

title_en: ‘Weak and dizzy’: the secretive ICE force-feeding tactics that ended a Cuban father’s hunger strike
title_zh: “虚弱头晕”：ICE秘密强制喂食策略结束了一位古巴父亲的绝食抗议

summary_zh: 独家：路易斯·亚历杭德罗·科拉·佩雷斯在得克萨斯州设施内发给《卫报》的信息中表示，强制喂食的痛苦导致他停止罢工。
body_en: Exclusive: Luis Alejandro Cora Pérez says in messages to Guardian from inside Texas facility pain of force-feeding caused him to break strike

T he text message that came from inside the Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detention center was stark: “I have spent five days eating regular food. If I don’t eat it, they put the tube in me to feed me.”

A Cuban asylum seeker, Luis Alejandro Cora Pérez, 32, said in messages to the Guardian this month that he was still weak and dizzy after three months without eating, but that he had broken his hunger strike because being force-fed was just too painful.
The Trump administration responded to requests for comment by denying it had force-fed Cora Pérez. But the detainee sent more details – and his is far from an isolated case.
Cora Pérez was one of two men on hunger striker at a Texas facility for whom ICE sought and received a federal judge’s permission to force-feed in recent weeks, a Guardian investigation found.

Cora Pérez and the other man were locked up inside the Port Isabel service processing center, an ICE detention facility in south Texas, just a few miles from the US-Mexico border , on the coast near where Elon Musk’s SpaceX launches rockets. Cora Pérez began a hunger strike in August to protest against his prolonged detention by federal immigration officials while his case plays out. At first he only drank water, then after three weeks, he says he began to drink one Ensure nutritional shake per day.
On 30 October, court records show ICE received permission to forcibly feed and hydrate him, and to restrain him while doing so.

The next day he says six guards at the center held him down, while medical staffers inserted a feeding tube through his nose and down his throat, and pumped nutritional liquid into his stomach – a process he called “traumatizing, both physically and psychologically”.

On 3 November, ICE then received permission from a federal judge to force-feed another hunger striker at Port Isabel, from Uzbekistan, federal court records show. The DHS says the Uzbek man has not been subjected to the practice, however.

On Wednesday night, after weeks of communications, Cora Pérez was suddenly transferred to another detention center in Texas. His relative says neither of them were alerted to any plans to transfer him, or a reason for it.
The DHS did not specify why Cora Pérez was transferred, adding that ICE makes custody determinations on a “case-by-case” basis based on “various factors”.

The revelations come as ICE’s detention practices continue to come under fire amid allegations of mistreatment , and as an increasing number of sporadic hunger strikes have been breaking out in ICE facilities across the country.

The two men’s cases in Texas, revealed here for the first time, are some of the most recent instances of government lawyers seeking a federal judge’s permission, as required by ICE policy, and receiving the go-ahead to force-feed detained hunger strikers. The Guardian’s reporting is based on court records, interviews, dozens of messages exchanged and an interview conducted with Cora Pérez via a facility phone. It further reveals how the Trump administration is increasingly obtaining such court orders to force-feed detained immigrants , a secretive practice widely condemned as torture by human rights organizations and medical ethics groups.
‘We are not criminals’: protests erupt as hunger strike rocks New Jersey ICE jail

Detainees driven to hunger strike are typically using it as a last resort to protest against poor conditions and the Trump administration’s preference for arrest and prolonged detention while their civil immigration cases proceed through the system.

Cora Pérez said detention center staff inserted the feeding tube and left it in his body, a not uncommon practice, according to experts, and introduced nutrition – first a “clear liquid”, followed by a “milky liquid”, he recalled – through the tube twice more that day, before he cracked and said he broke his hunger strike, citing what he called “horrific torture”. He began voluntarily drinking nutritional shakes the following day, he said.

“ICE does not hold back on anything, and they do anything they want, like we have seen, even killing their own US citizens,” he wrote to the Guardian, referring to the fatal shootings of Renee Good by an ICE officer and Alex Pretti by a border patrol officer in January of this year during Trump’s pivotal immigration crackdown on Minneapolis.

Detained hunger strikers subjected to involuntary medical procedures, including force-feeding, have rarely spoken out about their cases or revealed their identities, much less while still detained. Cora Pérez’s messages offer a rare glimpse at conditions inside a detention center’s restricted medical unit where hunger strikers and suicidal detainees are held.

“They just took [the Uzbek man] in an ambulance after [him] fainting in front of the medical lobby where they take our vitals, our weight and our temperature,” Cora Pérez said in an alarmed message last Monday morning.
body_zh: 独家报道：路易斯·亚历杭德罗·科拉·佩雷斯在德克萨斯州设施内发给《卫报》的信息中表示，强制喂食的痛苦导致他中断了罢工
来自移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 拘留中心的短信措辞鲜明：“我已经五天时间吃普通食物了。如果我不吃，他们就会把管子插入我体内喂我。”
32 岁的古巴寻求庇护者路易斯·亚历杭德罗·科拉·佩雷斯 (Luis Alejandro Cora Pérez) 本月在给《卫报》的留言中表示，三个月没有进食后，他仍然感到虚弱和头晕，但他已经打破了绝食，因为强制灌食太痛苦了。
特朗普政府回应置评请求时否认曾对科拉·佩雷斯进行强行灌食。但被拘留者提供了更多细节——他的案件绝非孤例。
《卫报》的一项调查发现，最近几周，ICE 寻求并获得联邦法官的许可，对德克萨斯州一处设施中的两名绝食男子进行强制喂食，科拉·佩雷斯 (Cora Pérez) 就是其中之一。
科拉·佩雷斯和另一名男子被关在伊莎贝尔港服务处理中心内，这是德克萨斯州南部的 ICE 拘留设施，距离美墨边境仅几英里，位于埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 发射火箭的海岸附近。科拉·佩雷斯 (Cora Pérez) 于八月开始绝食，抗议联邦移民官员在案件审理期间长期拘留他。一开始他只喝水，三周后，他说他开始每天喝一杯Ensure营养奶昔。
10 月 30 日，法庭记录显示 ICE 获得许可，可以强行给他喂食和补充水分，并在这样做时限制他。
第二天，他说中心的六名警卫将他按倒，医务人员将一根喂食管插入他的鼻子和喉咙，并将营养液注入他的胃中——他称这一过程“对身体和心理都造成了创伤”。
联邦法院记录显示，11 月 3 日，ICE 获得一名联邦法官的许可，对伊莎贝尔港另一名来自乌兹别克斯坦的绝食抗议者进行强制喂食。不过，国土安全部表示，这名乌兹别克男子并未遭受这种做法。
经过数周的沟通后，周三晚上，科拉·佩雷斯突然被转移到德克萨斯州的另一个拘留中心。他的亲戚说，他们都没有得知任何转移他的计划或原因。
国土安全部没有具体说明科拉·佩雷斯被转移的原因，并补充说，ICE 根据“各种因素”“逐案”做出拘留决定。
这些消息曝光之际，ICE 的拘留做法因虐待指控而继续受到批评，而且全国各地的 ICE 设施中爆发了越来越多的零星绝食抗议。
德克萨斯州首次披露的这两起案件是政府律师根据 ICE 政策要求寻求联邦法官许可，并获得批准对被拘留的绝食抗议者进行强制喂食的最新案例。 《卫报》的报道基于法庭记录、采访、数十条交换的消息以及通过设施电话对科拉·佩雷斯进行的采访。它进一步揭示了特朗普政府如何越来越多地获得此类法院命令，对被拘留的移民进行强制喂食，这种秘密做法被人权组织和医学伦理团体广泛谴责为酷刑。
“我们不是罪犯”：新泽西州 ICE 监狱绝食引发抗议活动
被迫绝食的被拘留者通常将其作为最后手段，以抗议恶劣的条件以及特朗普政府在民事移民案件通过该系统处理期间倾向于逮捕和长期拘留的做法。
科拉·佩雷斯说，拘留中心的工作人员将喂食管插入他的体内，据专家称，这种做法并不少见，并通过喂食管引入了营养——他回忆道，首先是“透明液体”，然后是“乳状液体”——当天又两次通过喂食管，然后他崩溃了，并说他打破了绝食抗议，并引用了他所说的“可怕的酷刑”。他说，第二天他开始自愿喝营养奶昔。
他在给《卫报》的信中写道：“ICE 不会阻止任何事情，他们想为所欲为，就像我们所看到的那样，甚至杀害自己的美国公民。”他指的是今年 1 月特朗普在明尼阿波利斯实施关键移民镇压期间，一名 ICE 官员和一名边境巡逻人员分别枪杀蕾妮·古德 (Renee Good) 和亚历克斯·普雷蒂 (Alex Pretti)。
被拘留的绝食抗议者接受包括强制喂食在内的非自愿医疗程序，很少说出自己的情况或透露自己的身份，更不用说在仍被拘留时了。科拉·佩雷斯的信息让人们难得一睹拘留中心受限医疗室的状况，那里关押着绝食抗议者和自杀倾向的被拘留者。
科拉·佩雷斯上周一早上在一条令人震惊的信息中表示：“[这名乌兹别克男子]在医疗大厅前晕倒后，他们将他送上了救护车，并在那里测量了我们的生命体征、体重和体温。”

title_en: Haitians excited but uneasy as El Salvador troops fight gangs
title_zh: 萨尔瓦多军队打击帮派，海地人兴奋但不安
summary: Foreign combatants in Port-au-Prince welcomed by many after years of gang control but some fear offensive could exacerbate volatile situation A bullet-peppered mural of the Haitian striker Emmanuel Sanon covers the facade of Port-au-Prince’s main football grou
summary_zh: 经过多年的帮派控制后，太子港的外国战斗人员受到许多人的欢迎，但一些人担心进攻可能会加剧不稳定的局势
body_en: Foreign combatants in Port-au-Prince welcomed by many after years of gang control but some fear offensive could exacerbate volatile situation
A bullet-peppered mural of the Haitian striker Emmanuel Sanon covers the facade of Port-au-Prince’s main football ground. But more than two years have passed since any sports stars graced the pitch.

In 2024, as the surrounding city was almost entirely captured by heavily armed gangs , Sylvio Cator stadium – where football greats including Brazil’s Ronaldo and Roberto Carlos once played – also fell under criminal control, its dilapidated red and blue stands used as an outpost by fighters working for a gang boss called Izo. Haiti’s national team, the Grenadiers, found itself homeless and was forced to play its World Cup qualifying games abroad .

That changed last week, as Haitian police and troops from El Salvador reconquered the stadium. Nayib Bukele, El Salvador’s authoritarian president, called the development a step towards delivering Haiti from a criminal insurrection that has displaced more than 1.5 million people and killed thousands.
“We now have the upper hand on the ground,” claimed Bukele , who has sent more than 2,000 soldiers to Haiti since mid-October.

Outside the Sylvio Cator stadium, named after an acclaimed Haitian athlete who won a silver medal at the 1928 Olympics, there were joyous scenes as citizens celebrated a foreign politician they hope will prove an unlikely saviour.
“There’s a wind of hope blowing through our country and, thanks to God, we will get through this. Long live Bukele!” said a 55-year-old decorator who asked to be named as Bòs Baton.

Stood by Sanon’s battle-scarred fresco, Baton recalled being driven from an area called Poste-Marchand after criminals set his home ablaze during an armed uprising that started in February 2024 . “Today, we are happy because there are places we couldn’t go to before that are accessible – and it’s thanks to Bukele’s intervention that we can be here today,” Baton said.

Identical sentiments have been voiced on the streets of El Salvador’s capital, San Salvador, in recent years as a result of Bukele’s controversial anti-gang crusade , which has freed millions from gang rule – albeit at a high price.

Since that crackdown began in early 2022 , more than 90,000 Salvadorans have been jailed as part of a mass incarceration campaign that has slashed murder rates but also fuelled fears that El Salvador’s democracy has died .

Bukele’s domestic clampdown has made the millennial strongman a darling for rightwing politicians and voters across Latin America and the Caribbean, who hold his actions up as proof that, with an iron fist and a malleable approach to human rights, rampant criminality can be tamed.
Now, as Bukele seeks to extend his seven-year presidency in an election in February, he is hoping to burnish his gang-busting credentials overseas.

“It’s an operation that projects force, that projects Bukele’s image as the saviour … and positions El Salvador as a key reference in the region for [how] … to deal with gangs and security,” said Tiziano Breda, a Latin America regional expert from the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data project.

The extent of Bukele’s ambitions in Haiti is unclear. The operation’s trigger was the 18 October abduction of four Salvadoran aviation technicians who worked for a UN-backed security force. On Monday, Bukele’s vice-president, Félix Ulloa, announced Salvadoran troops would withdraw as soon as the four men were rescued, “because this is not an occupying force – we are not there to stay”.
But Ulloa also said his government was responding altruistically “to a cry for help from the Haitian people and government”, suggesting its mission could be extended.
‘Potentially ugly’: taking war on gangs to Haiti poses risks for El Salvador’s leader
Bukele has also hinted his plans go beyond short-lived ground operations to recover his citizens, or their remains. “We will triumph. God will give us victory,” the politician vowed this week.

Many Haitians hope his combatants will stay and have been thrilled by cinematic social media clips posted by Bukele showing helicopter strikes on a gang compound and the mansion of a gangster nicknamed Taliban.
Banners and billboards around Port-au-Prince celebrate Bukele as a 21st-century liberator and feature slogans such as “The bandits won’t get a wink of sleep!” and “We’re tired! Give us Bukele!”
body_zh: 经过多年的帮派控制后，太子港的外国战斗人员受到许多人的欢迎，但一些人担心进攻可能会加剧不稳定的局势
太子港主要足球场的正面覆盖着海地前锋伊曼纽尔·萨农的一幅布满子弹的壁画。但两年多过去了，体育明星不再出现在球场上。
2024 年，由于周围的城市几乎完全被全副武装的帮派占领，西尔维奥·卡托体育场（巴西球星罗纳尔多和罗伯托·卡洛斯等足球巨星曾在这里踢球）也受到了犯罪分子的控制，其破旧的红蓝看台被帮派头目伊佐手下的战士用作前哨基地。海地国家队掷弹兵队无家可归，被迫在国外参加世界杯预选赛。
上周情况发生了变化，海地警察和萨尔瓦多军队重新占领了体育场。萨尔瓦多独裁总统纳伊布·布克莱 (Nayib Bukele) 称，这一进展是海地摆脱犯罪叛乱的一步，这场叛乱导致超过 150 万人流离失所，数千人死亡。
布克莱声称：“我们现在在实地占据了上风。”自10月中旬以来，他已向海地派遣了2000多名士兵。
西尔维奥·卡托体育场（Sylvio Cator Stadium）以一位在 1928 年奥运会上获得银牌的著名海地运动员的名字命名，外面充满了欢乐的场景，民众庆祝一位外国政治家，他们希望这位外国政治家成为不太可能的救世主。
“希望之风吹过我们的国家，感谢上帝，我们一定能渡过难关。布克莱万岁！”一位不愿透露姓名的 55 岁装修师博斯·巴顿 (Bòs Baton) 说道。
巴顿站在萨农那幅饱经战火的壁画前，回忆起 2024 年 2 月开始的武装起义期间，犯罪分子放火烧毁了他的家，之后他被赶出了一个名为 Poste-Marchand 的地区。巴顿说：“今天，我们很高兴，因为以前不能去的地方现在可以到达了——多亏了布克莱的干预，我们今天才能来到这里。”
近年来，由于布克莱颇具争议的反帮派运动，萨尔瓦多首都圣萨尔瓦多的街道上也表达了同样的情绪，该运动使数百万人摆脱了帮派统治——尽管付出了高昂的代价。
自 2022 年初开始镇压以来，作为大规模监禁运动的一部分，已有 9 万多名萨尔瓦多人被监禁，该运动大幅降低了谋杀率，但也加剧了人们对萨尔瓦多民主已消亡的担忧。
布克莱在国内的镇压行动使这位千禧一代的强人成为拉丁美洲和加勒比地区右翼政客和选民的宠儿，他们认为布克莱的行为证明，通过铁腕和灵活的人权方针，可以遏制猖獗的犯罪行为。
现在，布克莱寻求在二月份的选举中延长他的七年总统任期，他希望在海外提升自己打击帮派的资历。
武装冲突地点和事件数据项目的拉丁美洲地区专家蒂齐亚诺·布雷达 (Tiziano Breda) 表示：“这是一项投射武力的行动，投射布克莱的救世主形象……并将萨尔瓦多定位为该地区[如何]……应对帮派和安全的关键参考。”
布克莱在海地的野心有多大尚不清楚。这次行动的导火索是 10 月 18 日绑架了为联合国支持的安全部队工作的四名萨尔瓦多航空技术人员。周一，布克莱副总统菲利克斯·乌略亚宣布，一旦四人获救，萨尔瓦多军队将立即撤军，“因为这不是占领军——我们不会留在那里”。
但乌略亚还表示，他的政府正在无私地回应“海地人民和政府的求助呼声”，并暗示其使命可以延长。
“可能很丑陋”：对海地帮派发动战争给萨尔瓦多领导人带来风险
布克莱还暗示，他的计划不仅仅是短期的地面行动，旨在找回他的公民或他们的遗体。 “我们会胜利。上帝会给我们胜利，”这位政客本周发誓。
许多海地人希望他的战斗人员能够留下来，并且对布克莱发布的社交媒体电影片段感到兴奋，这些片段显示直升机袭击了一个帮派大院和一个绰号为塔利班的帮派的豪宅。
太子港周围的横幅和广告牌庆祝布克莱作为 21 世纪的解放者，并标有诸如“强盗不会合眼！”等口号。和“我们累了！给我们布克莱！”

title_en: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
title_zh: 据报道，联邦调查局正在调查其犯罪数据库明显遭到黑客攻击
summary: The National Crime Information Center database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information.
summary_zh: 联邦和地方执法部门使用国家犯罪信息中心数据库来共享信息。
body_en: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its criminal information database, US media reports, citing two people briefed on the issue.
The National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information on warrants and background checks.
It would not be the first time hackers have targeted the FBI, the domestic intelligence and security service of the US. The agency did not respond to the BBC's request for comment.
When asked about the breach in a Fox News interview on Saturday, President Donald Trump said he had "just heard" about the hack. "I will say that it's not good. I don't like that," he said.
"But maybe we'll learn things that we would've never learned otherwise," Trump added.

This apparent breach of FBI database comes after a string of tech outages which hit banking, air traffic control and other sectors in the US last week. Officials have said they were not caused by cyber-attacks, but the blackouts have sparked scrutiny from lawmakers.
White House National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross was fired this week, with Trump saying he was not good enough.

Dan Lorhmann, a former analyst for the National Security Agency (NSA), told the BBC News Channel that the NCIC's data included "critical information relating to nationwide criminal activity" and needed to be protected.
He added that while US security agencies including the FBI have "an amazing ability" to keep such information safe" and are "globally respected", the level of cyber-attacks is rising globally.
"There's a lot of different reasons why that's happening but I do have faith in our experts in government," Lorhmann said.
In September, the FBI said it was investigating an apparent breach by a cyber-crime group ShinyHunters, which claimed it had stolen sensitive information on all bureau staff - around 38,000 people.

After that hack, one former FBI agent told the BBC he feared for the safety of current employees, whose personal information could soon become available online to criminals and hostile nation-state hackers.
In a separate development, NBC reported an apparent cyberattack against the US Department of Agriculture (USDA).
Employees were informed on Thursday that its farm payment system had been targeted, NBC said.
The USDA has not publicly commented on the issue.
body_zh: 美国媒体援引两名知情人士的话报道称，联邦调查局正在调查其犯罪信息数据库明显遭到破坏的事件。
联邦和地方执法部门使用国家犯罪信息中心 (NCIC) 数据库来共享有关逮捕令和背景调查的信息。
这并不是黑客第一次针对美国国内情报和安全部门联邦调查局 (FBI)。该机构没有回应 BBC 的置评请求。
唐纳德·特朗普总统在周六接受福克斯新闻采访时被问及此次黑客攻击事件时表示，他“刚刚听说”了此次黑客攻击。 “我会说这不好。我不喜欢这样，”他说。
特朗普补充道：“但也许我们会学到一些我们永远不会学到的东西。”
上周，美国银行业、空中交通管制和其他部门发生一系列技术中断事件，导致联邦调查局数据库明显遭到破坏。官员们表示，这不是由网络攻击引起的，但停电事件引发了立法者的审查。
白宫国家网络主任肖恩·凯恩克罗斯本周被解雇，特朗普称他不够好。
美国国家安全局 (NSA) 前分析师 Dan Lorhmann 告诉 BBC 新闻频道，NCIC 的数据包括“与全国犯罪活动有关的关键信息”，需要受到保护。
他补充说，尽管包括联邦调查局在内的美国安全机构拥有“惊人的能力”来确保此类信息的安全，并且“受到全球的尊重”，但全球网络攻击的程度正在上升。
洛曼说：“发生这种情况的原因有很多，但我确实对政府专家充满信心。”
9 月，FBI 表示正在调查网络犯罪组织 ShinyHunters 的一起明显违规行为，该组织声称窃取了联邦调查局所有工作人员（约 38,000 人）的敏感信息。
在那次黑客攻击之后，一名前联邦调查局特工告诉英国广播公司，他担心现任员工的安全，他们的个人信息很快就会被犯罪分子和敌对的民族国家黑客在网上获取。
在另一项进展中，NBC 报道了针对美国农业部 (USDA) 的明显网络攻击。
NBC 称，员工周四获悉其农场支付系统已成为攻击目标。
美国农业部尚未对此问题公开发表评论。

title_en: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
title_zh: 丹麦指责俄罗斯密谋暗杀美国-乌克兰说唱歌手
summary: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.
summary_zh: 俄罗斯驻丹麦大使馆否认了这一指控，这导致俄罗斯国防武官被驱逐。
body_en: Denmark has accused Russian intelligence services of plotting to assassinate a Ukrainian-American near Copenhagen, saying they had "planned" and "initiated" the attempt.

Denmark's security and intelligence agency (PET) said it had stopped individuals who were intending to kill the person, named by Danish media as rapper Kyivstoner, at a concert in September. Two people were charged with attempted murder and assisting a foreign intelligence service, and pleaded not guilty.
Denmark's foreign minister said Russia's defence attaché will now be expelled.
Russia's embassy in Denmark called the allegations "unsubstantiated" and said Copenhagen failed to provide evidence of Moscow's involvement.

In a statement, the embassy claimed a "Danish model" had emerged, which it described as a "Russian trace" allegedly being discovered and "exploited for a propaganda spectacle". It accused Denmark of "provocations" intending to "frighten the Danish population in order to justify... a prolonged confrontation with Russia".
Russian state media cite the foreign ministry in Moscow as saying it will respond to the expulsion of its official "accordingly".

In a statement on Saturday, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said: "I strongly condemn the assassination attempt against a US-Ukrainian citizen in Denmark, orchestrated by Russian intelligence services.
"This was an attack on EU soil. And it is unacceptable," she said, adding that "Russia's hybrid threats are becoming less and less hybrid, and more and more real."

PET said the individuals who allegedly tried to assassinate him were associated with a banned Danish gang named Loyal to Familia. The group is "known for extensive, serious and violent criminal activity", according to the agency.
PET, which worked with police on the case, said three individuals were stopped while travelling by car near the music venue where Kyivstoner was set to perform on 25 September.
Firearms and knives were found in the vehicle, PET said.
Since then, two people linked to the case have been charged with attempted murder and assisting a foreign intelligence service.
Both individuals pleaded not guilty to the charges, local media reported.

In July, Russia's FSB security service accused Vasiliev and the Ukrainian authorities of organising a "terrorist attack" on military facilities and personnel in Russia. The rapper denied this allegation on social media.

In a statement on Friday, Danish Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen said the alleged assassination attempt was Russian "intimidation" and an attempt to make Denmark "waver" in its support for Ukraine.
Russia's defence attaché must leave the country within seven days, Rasmussen said.

He also said Denmark wants the EU to restrict the ability of Russians to travel throughout Europe, saying even though Copenhagen was already very reluctant to issue visas, Russians could still get a Schengen visa in another country and travel to Denmark.
Copenhagen wants these visas to apply only in the country that has issued them, he added.
Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
body_zh: 丹麦指责俄罗斯情报部门密谋在哥本哈根附近暗杀一名乌克兰裔美国人，称他们“策划”并“发起”了这一企图。
丹麦安全和情报机构 (PET) 表示，已在 9 月份的一场音乐会上阻止了那些打算杀害这名被丹麦媒体称为说唱歌手基夫斯通纳 (Kyivstoner) 的人的人。两人被指控谋杀未遂和协助外国情报部门，但他们均不不认罪。
丹麦外交部长表示，俄罗斯武官现在将被驱逐。
俄罗斯驻丹麦大使馆称这些指控“未经证实”，并表示哥本哈根未能提供莫斯科参与其中的证据。
大使馆在一份声明中声称已经出现了“丹麦模式”，并将其描述为“俄罗斯痕迹”，据称被发现并“被用于宣传奇观”。它指责丹麦进行“挑衅”，旨在“恐吓丹麦民众，以便为……​​与俄罗斯的长期对抗辩护”。
俄罗斯官方媒体援引莫斯科外交部的话说，它将“相应地”对其官员被驱逐做出回应。
欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩在周六的一份声明中表示：“我强烈谴责俄罗斯情报部门在丹麦策划的针对一名美国乌克兰公民的暗杀企图。
“这是对欧盟领土的攻击。这是不可接受的，”她说，并补充说，“俄罗斯的混合威胁正变得越来越不混合，而越来越真实。”
PET 表示，据称试图暗杀他的人与一个名为 Loyal to Familia 的被禁丹麦帮派有关联。该机构称，该组织“以广泛、严重和暴力的犯罪活动而闻名”。
与警方合作处理此案的 PET 表示，三人在基辅斯通纳将于 9 月 25 日演出的音乐场地附近驾车行驶时被拦截。
PET 表示，在车内发现了枪支和刀具。
此后，两名与此案有关的人被指控谋杀未遂和协助外国情报部门。
据当地媒体报道，两人均对指控表示不认罪。
7月，俄罗斯联邦安全局安全部门指责瓦西里耶夫和乌克兰当局组织对俄罗斯军事设施和人员的“恐怖袭击”。这位说唱歌手在社交媒体上否认了这一指控。
丹麦外交部长拉斯穆森在周五的一份声明中表示，所谓的暗杀企图是俄罗斯的“恐吓”，目的是让丹麦“动摇”对乌克兰的支持。
拉斯穆森说，俄罗斯武官必须在七天内离开该国。

title_en: Lebanese president demands Israel withdrawal, decries Iran’s interference
title_zh: 黎巴嫩总统要求以色列撤军，谴责伊朗干涉
summary: Joseph Aoun says 'two fundamental obstacles, inseparably linked' mean Lebanon cannot fully celebrate its independence.
summary_zh: 约瑟夫·奥恩表示，“两个不可分割的根本障碍”意味着黎巴嫩无法完全庆祝其独立。
body_en: Share Lebanese president demands Israel withdrawal, decries Iran’s interference on social media
Lebanese President Joseph Aoun has decried Iran’s meddling in Lebanon’s affairs and demanded Israel’s withdrawal from his country’s south.

In a speech on Saturday, on the eve of Lebanon’s 83rd independence anniversary, Aoun said Lebanon faces two interconnected fateful tests: the “Israeli occupation of parts of our land” and “foreign interference” from “some influential parties in the Iranian regime” through weapons and decisions outside the authority of the Lebanese state.

These “two fundamental obstacles, inseparably linked” mean that Lebanon cannot fully celebrate its independence, he added.
“Withdraw from every inch of Lebanese territory. Stop your attacks. And return our captives,” Aoun demanded of Israel.
Dozens of Lebanese citizens are believed to be held in Israeli detention centres , including civilians as well as members of the Hezbollah armed group captured during fighting in southern Lebanon.

The president also pledged to press ahead with plans to bring all weapons under state control, declaring that there would be “no weapons outside the state that take orders from, or serve the interests of foreign powers.”
“You must hand over your weapons,” Aoun said.

Lebanon’s government has promised to disarm Hezbollah, the Iran-backed Lebanese group whose arsenal has long outstripped that of the national army and that has justified its weapons as necessary to resist Israel.

Lebanon and Israel signed a framework agreement in June, following US-mediated talks, which included the disarmament of Hezbollah, a gradual Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanese territories and the deployment of the Lebanese army to the area.
But implementation has stalled, with Hezbollah refusing to surrender its weapons and Israel continuing to strike Lebanon.
On Saturday, Israeli strikes hit the districts of Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil and Marjayoun in southern Lebanon.
Al Jazeera correspondents reported that one of the air strikes hit the outskirts of Baraachit, a town in Bint Jbeil.
They said Baraachit came under Israeli gunfire at dawn and reported the movement of Israeli military vehicles on the outskirts of the town.
Israeli warplanes launched a second missile attack on the town of Kfar Tebnit in Nabatieh, after the first failed to detonate, according to Lebanon’s National News Agency (NNA).
The NNA reported that Israeli forces carried out three explosions in Wadi al-Khiam in the Marjayoun district, but gave no further details.
Israeli attacks in southern Lebanon have killed at least 4,386 people and wounded 12,407 others since March 2, when the latest Hezbollah-Israel war started.

据信，数十名黎巴嫩公民被关押在以色列拘留中心，其中包括平民以及在黎巴嫩南部战斗中被俘的真主党武装组织成员。
总统还承诺继续推进将所有武器置于国家控制之下的计划，并宣称“国家之外不会有任何武器接受外国势力的命令或服务于外国势力的利益”。

title_en: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock
title_zh: 化石燃料之争使COP31气候谈判陷入僵局
summary: Countries from nearly 200 countries are in a deadlock to try and get a new global climate agreement.
summary_zh: 来自近 200 个国家的国家在试图达成新的全球气候协议方面陷入僵局。
body_en: Senior climate and science journalist , Reporting from Antalya, Turkey

Negotiations at the COP31 UN climate summit in Turkey are in deadlock and have been suspended for the night, after running more than a day over time, as countries have been unable to agree on a new global climate deal.
The EU and Pacific island nations are amongst a group pushing back against the latest draft agreement which included no reference to reducing the world's demand for fossil fuels.
A second sticking point involves a push from the Africa Group to get commitments on more money for adaptation - but the EU has previously said it would not support this.
Negotiating teams due to fly out on Sunday morning are now moving their flights to Monday in a sign that a deal is not yet in sight.
If countries cannot reach consensus - which is required by the UN's climate talks process - the negotiations could be suspended.
In that case the summit would end with no deal and be reconvened next year. This has only happened once before since countries started holding COP climate meetings in 1995.
On Saturday, EU Commissioner for Climate Wopke Hoekstra said if the bloc could not get "what is needed in terms of climate action... then there's no deal."
The UK's chief negotiator, Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh, remained more hopeful and said her team was still working to get an agreement.

"These are difficult negotiations, but discussions remain productive and there is a deal to be done. The UK is pushing hard for an outcome and we will keep working in the coming hours to bring countries together."
Another risk is that negotiating teams have to start journeys home, and the meeting could lose the critical number of nations needed to pass any global agreement.
More climate money for Africa? Europe says use what's already pledged

Ministers from Panama, Solomon Islands, Cote d'Ivoire and the EU are fighting to get a commitment to move away from oil, gas and coal back into the final agreement after fossil fuel producers led by Saudi Arabia pushed for its removal.

"It is not acceptable to have a COP or a cover decision that does not even mention fossil fuels and we simply will not put up with it," said Juan Carlos Navarro, Panama's minister for the environment.
His words were echoed by France's Minister of Ecological Transition, Monique Barbut.

She took aim at several references in the text to carbon capture, use and storage - the technology that takes emissions when they are released and stores them underground - as a licence for other countries to keep burning oil and gas.
"We cannot be announcing to the world that we are now getting to 1.5 increase in the temperature and do business like nothing was happening," Barbut said.
For the first time at a COP the agreement - known officially as the Antalya Accords - could acknowledge that the goal of keeping global temperature rise below 1.5C has been missed.
The world is entering a period called "overshoot".
Beyond this point scientists warn , external that millions more people will be exposed to sea level rise and extreme heat.
body_zh: 高级气候与科学记者，土耳其安塔利亚报道
在土耳其举行的第 31 届联合国气候变化大会 (COP31) 上的谈判陷入僵局，并在经过一天多的时间后暂停了一晚，原因是各国未能就新的全球气候协议达成一致。
欧盟和太平洋岛国是反对最新协议草案的群体之一，该协议草案没有提到减少世界对化石燃料的需求。
第二个症结在于非洲集团推动获得更多资金用于适应的承诺，但欧盟此前曾表示不会支持这一点。
原定于周日早上出发的谈判团队现在将航班改至周一，这表明协议尚未达成。
如果各国无法达成共识——这是联合国气候谈判进程所要求的——谈判可能会暂停。
在这种情况下，峰会将在没有达成任何协议的情况下结束，并于明年重新召开。自 1995 年各国开始召开 COP 气候会议以来，这种情况只发生过一次。
周六，欧盟气候专员沃普克·霍克斯特拉(Wopke Hoekstra)表示，如果欧盟无法获得“气候行动所需的东西……那么就不会达成协议。”
英国首席谈判代表、能源大臣米亚塔·法恩布拉(Miatta Fahnbulleh)仍然充满希望，并表示她的团队仍在努力达成协议。
“这些谈判很艰难，但讨论仍然富有成效，并且有一项协议需要完成。英国正在努力推动取得成果，我们将在未来几个小时内继续努力，让各国走到一起。”
另一个风险是谈判团队必须启程回国，而会议可能会失去通过任何全球协议所需的关键数量的国家。
为非洲提供更多气候资金？欧洲表示使用已经承诺的资金
在以沙特阿拉伯为首的化石燃料生产国推动取消石油、天然气和煤炭承诺后，巴拿马、所罗门群岛、科特迪瓦和欧盟的部长们正在努力争取将石油、天然气和煤炭的承诺重新纳入最终协议中。
巴拿马环境部长胡安·卡洛斯·纳瓦罗表示：“缔约方大会或封面决定甚至不提及化石燃料，这是不可接受的，我们根本不会容忍。”
他的话得到了法国生态转型部长莫尼克·巴布的回应。
她瞄准了文中多次提到的碳捕获、使用和储存——这种技术在释放排放物时将其储存在地下——作为其他国家继续燃烧石油和天然气的许可证。
巴布特说：“我们不能向世界宣布气温已上升 1.5 度，却又像什么都没发生一样开展业务。”
该协议（正式名称为《安塔利亚协议》）首次在缔约方大会上承认，将全球气温升幅控制在 1.5 摄氏度以下的目标已经实现。
世界正在进入一个被称为“超调”的时期。
超过这一点，科学家对外警告说，数百万人将面临海平面上升和极端高温的影响。

title_en: Lock of former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000
title_zh: 美国前总统乔治·华盛顿的一缕头发售价4000美元
summary: The hair was given as a sign of friendship shortly before Washington's death in 1799, according to a descendent of its former owner.
summary_zh: 据这头头发前主人的后裔称，这头头发是在 1799 年华盛顿去世前不久赠送的，作为友谊的象征。
body_en: A framed lock of hair from America's first president, George Washington, has been sold at auction for $4,000 (£3,058).

The hair once belonged to John Gadsby, who entertained Washington in 1799 just before the latter's death the same year, and was later obtained by a collector called John K Lattimer from a descendent of Gadsby's, according to Richmond Auctions, which sold the item.

Saturday's sale is not the most expensive for Washington hair at auction. Three strands thought to have been removed from him close to or after his death stored in a locket sold for nearly $40,000 in 2021.

Gadsby, a resident of what in 1799 was the town of Alexandria in Virginia, entertained Washington for dinner shortly before his death later that year, according to a testament given in 1928 by Gadsby's granddaughter, Julia Ten Eyck McBlair, and which was posted on the Richmond Auctions website.

McBlair stated that her grandfather came into possession of Washington's hair "in view of the friendship and association with his last days" and had it framed and hung "under General Washington's portrait in our home in Washington City, there I have seen it all my life".
Gadsby hosted Washington's two birthday celebrations in 1798 and 1799, Richmond Auctions states.

Washington led American forces to victory against the British in the War of Independence and helped draft the US Constitution before becoming the country's first president in 1788. He stepped down in 1797 after serving two terms.
Several locks of Washington's hair have been preserved, including at least 50 examples that are in a collection at his former residence, Mount Vernon, which is now a museum.
"Public displays of hair from friends or loved ones peaked in the 19th century, but had long been popular among affluent families like the Washingtons," a blog on the Mount Vernon website states.
As well as lockets of his hair, other items associated with Washington have also done well at auction.
In July, a signed letter by Washington from 1776, in which he asks for soldiers for the Continental Army to fight the British, sold for $109,800.

body_zh: 美国第一任总统乔治·华盛顿的一绺头发在拍卖会上以 4,000 美元（3,058 英镑）的价格售出。
这根头发曾属于约翰·盖茨比 (John Gadsby)，他于 1799 年华盛顿去世前夕招待华盛顿，据出售该物品的里士满拍卖行 (Richmond Auctions) 称，后来，一位名叫约翰·K·拉蒂默 (John K Lattimer) 的收藏家从盖茨比的后裔那里获得了这根头发。
周六的拍卖并不是华盛顿头发拍卖中最贵的一次。据信，三根项链是在他去世前或去世后从他身上取下的，存放在一个挂坠盒中，于 2021 年以近 4 万美元的价格售出。
根据盖兹比的孙女朱莉娅·十·艾克·麦克布莱尔 (Julia Ten Eyck McBlair) 1928 年在里士满拍卖网站上发布的一份遗嘱，盖兹比是 1799 年弗吉尼亚州亚历山大镇的居民，他在当年晚些时候去世前不久曾招待华盛顿共进晚餐。
麦克布莱尔表示，她的祖父“鉴于与他最后日子的友谊和联系”而拥有了华盛顿的头发，并将其装裱起来并挂在“我们在华盛顿市家里的华盛顿将军的肖像下，我一生都在那里看到它”。
里士满拍卖公司称，盖茨比于 1798 年和 1799 年两次主办了华盛顿的生日庆祝活动。
华盛顿领导美国军队在独立战争中战胜了英国，并帮助起草了美国宪法，然后于 1788 年成为美国第一任总统。他在连任两届后于 1797 年下台。
华盛顿的几绺头发被保存下来，其中至少有 50 根头发被收藏在他的故居弗农山庄（现为博物馆）。
“公开展示朋友或亲人的头发在 19 世纪达到顶峰，但长期以来在华盛顿家族等富裕家庭中很流行，”弗农山网站上的博客称。
除了他的头发挂坠盒外，其他与华盛顿有关的物品也在拍卖会上取得了不错的成绩。
7 月，一封由华盛顿签署的 1776 年信函以 109,800 美元的价格售出，信中他请求大陆军士兵与英国作战。
